reference_kind: Saved MATLAB evaluation outputs; no rerun of MATLAB was required.
provenance_notes: SimRISM14_eval.m calls S2Q1JAN, whose source is absent from the supplied folder. The supplied DZTR.m equation was empirically verified against all 1,132,200 saved postinitial ensemble releases: maximum difference 4.362732397567015e-12 m3/s.
Direct transcription of the legacy 1000-iteration daily loop for the first 366 days of member 0 reproduces saved storage exactly and release within 2.842170943040401e-14 m3/s.
Across all 100 evaluation members and the complete 11323-day record, the maximum absolute trapezoidal water-balance residual is 1.0361254680901766e-06 m3.

The amalgam_out.mat sim/F arrays represent a different calendar from *_eval.mat. Reconstructed simulation states satisfy DZTR using a leap-year-start calendar rather than the actual 1970-start calendar. This supports an inferred calendar defect in the unavailable SimRISM12 calibration implementation; the specific leap start year cannot be established.
This fixture uses *_eval.mat outputs and their actual observation calendar, not the calendar-shifted amalgam_out.mat sim array. The candidate vectors come from amalgam_out.mat X.
The full-precision 2018 coefficient file is included only as the physical-configuration template. Each selected X vector supplies its own monthly targets.
Initial storage and release are coefficient-file constants rather than first observed values. Workbook observations use million m3; MAT observations and fixture storage use m3.
